identifiedBy.fact: Trailhead field: Cottonwood Lakes; Old Army Pass then Perrin Creek, class 2 rib to Joe Devel

otherFacts.value: SW aspect rises 3300 ft over Rock Creek in about 2 mi; PCT passes south and west
Chamberlin-Newcomb-Pickering-Joe Devel about 11 h from Perrin Creek camp (above 11,400 ft)

notes: WEAK-to-moderate. Two pages agree on the Horseshoe Meadow area: climber.org (Cottonwood Lakes TH, Old Army Pass) and backcountrysights (Horseshoe Meadows, Cottonwood Pass Trail to PCT then Rock Creek, west ridge). No page ties this route to one lot; Cottonwood Pass TH (USFS 36.448305,-118.170612) is a second lot about 0.6 km away, same meadow. Whitney Portal supported by no page. The approach is multi-day (cross-country via Rock Creek), so the lot is far from the summit (about 13 km). SummitPost 403.

notes: Two equally plausible starts: Mineral King via Glacier Pass or Timber Gap to Black Rock Pass and Little Five Lakes (climber.org 1998/355, which names Mineral King without a lot; candidates Farewell Gap-Franklin Lakes 36.44753,-118.594135 or Sawtooth 36.453305,-118.596761), versus the High Sierra Trail from Crescent Meadow (Wikipedia says the HST passes below the east slope). Nothing ties the 'Standard route' (East Ridge) to one start. Peakery and Wikipedia carry no trailhead. SummitPost and Peakbagger not retrievable.
